sv.title: Ella, 2, föddes vid busshållplats – nu firas hon där
sv.summary: Den 24 november 2024 var Sofie Carlson och Adam Linde på väg till sjukhuset när de insåg att de inte skulle hinna fram. Vid Kämpagårdens busshållplats fick de stanna och med 112 i telefonen fick Adam ta emot sin dotter i bilen. Trots den dramatiska förlossningen hann han aldrig bli rädd.

en.title: Ella, 2, was born at a bus stop – now she is celebrated there
en.summary: On 24 November 2024, Sofie Carlson and Adam Linde were on their way to the hospital when they realised they would not make it in time. At Kämpagården's bus stop they had to stop, and with 112 on the phone Adam had to deliver his daughter in the car. Despite the dramatic birth, he never had time to become scared.
